coaching.headline: We took both Fangtooths and led objective damage 18,881 to 253, but got caught alone nine times to their three.
coaching.team: Steel's solo death at 14.2 cost us our Outer Tower at 14.8, and the fight right after, lost 1-3, was the first game-defining swing — even though jungle and support were our two favored lanes, with carry, mid and offlane all losing theirs. The duo lane still opened well, with first blood on Dekker at minute 2, and the game held even through an 11.2 trade we won 2-1 but never converted. We took both Fangtooths, at minute 6 and minute 19, the second off an even 2-2 cross-map trade. Legion's solo death at 19.5 then opened a 4-against-5 we lost 0-2. Revenant's solo catch at 20.5 cost two towers in the minutes after. The game ended in a full wipe at 21.7, lost 0-5. We were caught alone nine times to their three; towers finished 3-3, objective damage 18,881 to 253, majors 9-14 them.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Revenant's solo catch by Yin at 20.5 cost two towers within the next 80 seconds, and the following teamfight, lost 0-5 at 21.7, ended the game.
coaching.whatWorked: We secured both Fangtooths, at minute 6 and minute 19, the second converted straight off an even 2-2 trade at Fangtooth.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Legion was one item short of the winning core (56.9% win rate), missing only Vanquisher — close enough that the losing lane explains this game more than the build does.

c40cff45-0059-42d9-b4b8-904c97556fda.build: Steel ran Necrosis and Terminus instead of the Xenia-Dynamo-Gaia Greaves core (56.4% win rate), with zero of five of us carrying armor into a 4-physical enemy comp — but no single fight isolates it as the cause of a specific death.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Zarus finished the Berserker's Axe-Augmentation core, missing only Tainted Blade from the winning build (53.3% win rate) — close to on-core, and his 11,478 objective damage bought both Fangtooths; nothing to fix in the items here.

focus.title: No armor against a 4-physical enemy comp
focus.evidence: Yin dealt 32,775 damage to heroes, the game's largest number, in a comp that was four-fifths physical; the matchup flags zero of five of us carrying armor.
focus.action: Send an armor item at the single biggest physical threat by the first full back, not just when the matchup flag already says so.

threats: Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
ourKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first
